leadText:
----
(Japanese: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu is a Famous Detective) is a Pokémon manga composed by Hiroshi Takase and illustrated by Yumiko Sudo. It was serialized in the CoroCoro Ichiban! magazine from the May 2005 issue (released on March 25, 2005) to the June 2015 issue (released on April 21, 2015). The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling.

Two volumes were released under the Tentōmusi Comics Special label from 2008 to 2009 and two volumes were released under the label from 2013 to 2015. The first two volumes center around and his team of Hoenn first partner Pokémon versus a team of , , and , with also appearing frequently. The final two volumes shift focus between Sinnoh, Johto, Unova, and Kalos first partner Pokémon along with Pikachu.
